newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Belgo begun as neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Belgo begun as neutral.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch & Co said it has begun coverage of Brazilian steel maker Companhia Siderurgica Belgo Mineira with a neutral rating for the immediate term.

-- "Uncertainties surrounding the possible near-term acquisition of Siderurgica Mendes Junior (SMJ) is expected to limit the near-term appreciation potential in the stock," the brokerage said in a report.
-- But, it added, for those investors willing to accept "the risks associated with the SMJ situation," the shares merit a long-term buy rating.
-- Merrill Lynch said that, once the SMJ issue is clarified and "assuming Belgo Mineira does not compromise its balance sheet," the firm's long-term earnings should improve.
-- Belgo holds leading market shares in its main products and is beginning an ambitious spending and cost-cutting program, the brokerage said.
-- With Brazil's economic recovery and prices improving slightly, Belgo should have strong earnings and cash flow growth in 1997 and beyond, Merrill Lynch said.
-- Belgo Mineira's preferred was off 0.05 reais at 64.45 reais, while its voting common was flat at 68.80 reais at 1305 local time/1005 EST on the Sao Paulo stock market.
